Type.name: Type
Type.definition: Type of additional action to perform.

OtherType.name: Other Type
OtherType.definition: Other action type to be performed.

Destination.name: Destination
Destination.definition: Destination of the additional action to perform.

DestinationType.name: Destination Type
DestinationType.definition: Type of destination of the additional action to perform.

DestinationAddress.name: Destination Address
DestinationAddress.definition: Physical destination address of the additional action to perform (for example, URL, mobile phone number, IP address, file name, etc.).

Format.name: Format
Format.definition: Format of the message associated with the additional action to perform.

OtherFormat.name: Other Format
OtherFormat.definition: Other type of format for action data.

Content.name: Content
Content.definition: Value of the content of or the reference to the message.

Signature.name: Signature
Signature.definition: Digital signature of the content of or the reference to the message.
